title: Jacob marries Leah and Rachel
summary: Jacob marries Leah and Rachel (Gen 29). Leah and Rachel’s marriage is distinct from Jacob’s flight to Laban.
description: Jacob marries Leah and Rachel (Gen 29). Leah and Rachel’s marriage is distinct from Jacob’s flight to Laban. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1759 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.date: 2245 1759 Marriage of Jacob to Leah & Rachel
chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
chronologies.note: The flight of Jacob to Laban is the existing event jacob-to-haran and was not edited. Leah has no person record.
